name: @slopmax/core
description: The engine as services and layers: accounts, credentials, providers, agents, pool, router, proxy, admin API, daemon, ledger

//.@decimalturn/toml-patch: Parses Codex's config.toml into a syntax tree with line positions, so `slopmax setup codex` and its undo change only slopmax's own lines and keep people's comments; its whole-document patch is the fallback for layouts the line edits cannot reach. Bun's TOML is parse-only.
//.@effect/platform-bun: Effect's FileSystem, Path, ChildProcessSpawner, sockets, DNS and HTTP server on Bun: the engine runs on Bun only, and these are the layers its services are built on.
//.ws: Codex's upstream WebSocket. Under Bun this is Bun's own implementation of the `ws` API: unlike the browser-style `WebSocket` it shows the headers of the upstream's 101 (the relay copies three of them to Codex), and it takes Bun's `proxy` and `tls` options, so the socket goes through the same upstream proxy and CA roots as every other call.
//.@types/ws: Types for the `ws` API that Bun implements.
